title: Tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground glow -->
  <rect x='8' y='78' width='84' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2b4a2b'/>
  <!-- tent body (left half) -->
  <polygon points='50,22 16,78 50,78' fill='#e8a33c'/>
  <!-- tent body (right half, shaded) -->
  <polygon points='50,22 84,78 50,78' fill='#b8762a'/>
  <!-- ridge highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- door opening -->
  <polygon points='50,44 38,78 62,78' fill='#3b2352'/>
  <!-- door flap left -->
  <polygon points='50,44 38,78 46,78 50,52' fill='#7a4bb5'/>
  <!-- door flap right -->
  <polygon points='50,44 62,78 54,78 50,52' fill='#5e3692'/>
  <!-- door inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8ce0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- pole top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='3' fill='#ffe6a3'/>
  <!-- side guy line -->
  <line x1='16' y1='78' x2='10' y2='84' stroke='#c9a35a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='78' x2='90' y2='84' stroke='#c9a35a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- pegs -->
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9ad68c'/>
  <rect x='88' y='82' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9ad68c'/>
</svg>
